title: Surreal Cosmic Fleur-de-Lis
description: A hand with pink nails holds a white bowl containing two astronauts, swirling colorful planets, and bubbles. To the left is a large ornate golden fleur-de-lis filled with colorful alien faces, set against a dark space background with constellations, nebulae, and floating celestial orbs.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large ornate golden fleur-de-lis on the left filled with multiple colorful alien and humanoid faces, next to a woman's hand with pink nails holding a white bowl containing two small astronauts standing in swirling pink and purple liquid, surrounded by floating planets, bubbles and orbs, all set against a dark starry space background with constellations and nebulae.
